source_record.title: Continuous Manual QA Tester for Backend and API-Only European Union @ Neuronation [31.200 - 52.000 €]
source_record.description:
Salary: 31.200 - 52.000 € per year

Requirements:
  • Proven experience in manual QA testing, particularly with backend and API testing.
  • Proficiency in API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Swagger, or similar).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify and clearly communicate defects and issues.
  • Excellent attention to detail, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Availability to work between 9:30 AM and 4:00 PM CET on weekdays.
  • A continuous learning attitude and commitment to process improvement.
  • Hands-on experience with payment system testing.
  • Familiarity with mobile application testing.
  • Manual QA testing, particularly with backend and API testing: 2 years.
  • Proficiency in API testing tools: 1 year.
  • Hands-on experience with payment system testing: 1 year.
  • Familiarity with mobile application testing: 1 year.
  • English required.
  • German preferred.
  • Must currently live in the European Union.
Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with our backend development team and product manager to plan and execute weekly sprint activities.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and sprint planning meetings, contributing insights to enhance product quality.
  • Perform comprehensive manual QA testing across both frontend and backend systems, with a primary emphasis on backend functionality.
  • Conduct direct API testing using appropriate tools to validate integration and performance.
  • Identify, analyze, and troubleshoot issues to accurately distinguish between client-side and server-side problems.
  • Manage and execute testing tasks efficiently within each sprint cycle.
  • Proactively suggest improvements, raise new tickets, and contribute ideas to elevate overall product quality.
Technologies:
  • API
  • Backend
  • Frontend
  • Support
  • Mobile
  • Postman
  • Product Manager
  • QA Testing
  • Swagger

More:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Manual QA Tester to support the ongoing quality assurance of our software products. In this role, you will play a key part in our development process, collaborating closely with our backend engineering team to ensure the reliability, performance, and functionality of our applications. This is a remote position with a minimum commitment of 30 hours per week and the option to expand to full-time. After an initial onboarding period, you will take ownership of backend QA processes. We require candidates to be located in Europe to support effective collaboration across our time zones. The contract length is 6 months, and the role is open as full-time, part-time, or temporary.
